create_scene_description_tool: create a SceneDescriptionTool instance with an event bus, config, API key, and camera endpoint names
describe_scene: call describe_scene with a call_id to get a Gemini-generated description of the robot environment from camera images
build_prompt_for_scene_description: call _build_prompt to assemble camera images and the scene description prompt template into a list
subscribe_to_model_image_input: subscribe the image buffer handler to MODEL_IMAGE_INPUT events on the event bus for scene description
configure_gemini_client_for_scene: configure a Gemini client wrapper with temperature zero and a thinking budget for scene description generation
